headline: HC Questions Automated Rejection of Form 8
summary: The Bombay High Court has raised questions over the automated rejection of Form 8 applications during Goa's electoral roll revision. The court is seeking clarity on the process behind these automatic rejections.

headline: 88 Deleted Goa Voters Restored to Roll
summary: Out of the 97 voters who were previously deleted from the electoral roll in Goa, 88 have been successfully restored.

headline: EC Restores 88 Voters, Identifies 3 Portuguese Citizens
summary: The Election Commission confirmed that 88 of the 97 left-out voters in Goa have been reinstated. Meanwhile, three others were found to be Portuguese citizens.

headline: Is a Foreign Holiday Cheaper Than Goa?
summary: An Indian traveller compared the expenses of holidaying in Goa with international destinations like Bali. The comparison highlights why traveling abroad is perceived as a more cost-effective option.

headline: Traveller Questions High Festive Costs in Goa
summary: A tourist questioned Goa's expensive festive rates after estimating a cost of Rs 2.5 lakh for a five-night stay. He suggested that trips to Vietnam or Bali might be more economical options.

headline: High Cost of Festive Holidays in Goa Sparks Debate
summary: An Indian traveller compared the high cost of a festive vacation in Goa to international alternatives like Bali and Vietnam. The comparison has sparked viral discussions online about domestic tourism pricing.

headline: Madgaon-Mangaluru Vande Bharat to Reach Bengaluru
summary: The Madgaon-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express is set to be extended to Bengaluru. This move is expected to significantly improve rail connectivity between Karnataka and Goa.

headline: Vande Bharat Express Route Extended to Bengaluru
summary: The Goa-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express will soon extend its operations all the way to Bengaluru. This extension aims to provide better travel options for passengers commuting between these cities.

headline: Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat to Extend to Bengaluru
summary: Plans are underway to extend the Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express to Bengaluru in the near future. This extension will enhance interstate connectivity and aid commuters.

headline: Ex-Councillor Arrested for Rs 8.1 Cr Land Fraud
summary: A former councillor has been arrested in connection with a multi-crore land scam in Goa. A Bengaluru-based company was allegedly cheated of Rs 8.1 crore in the fraudulent property deal.

headline: CBI Books Canara Bank Officials in Fixed Deposit Fraud
summary: The CBI has registered a case against four Canara Bank officials and two others for their alleged involvement in a multi-crore fixed deposit fraud.

headline: Two Murder Suspects Arrested While Fleeing to Goa
summary: Police have arrested two more suspects near Alibag while they were attempting to flee to Goa following the murder of a Thane Shiv Sena (UBT) leader. This brings the total number of arrests in the case to three.

headline: Diesel Tanker Falls Off Ferry at Adpai
summary: A private ferry dropped a diesel tanker into a waterbody at Adpai, raising safety concerns in the area. Local authorities are investigating the incident.

headline: Rosetta Hospitality Announces ₹650 Crore Expansion
summary: Rosetta Hospitality has earmarked ₹650 crore for its expansion plans across Sakleshpur, Goa, and Kallepura. The investment aims to boost its hospitality footprint in these regions.

headline: Goa to Export Vegetables via Mopa Airport
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that Goa will soon begin exporting vegetables to international markets through the Mopa Airport. This initiative aims to help local farmers reach global consumers.

headline: HC Questions ECI on Automated Rejection of Form 8
summary: The Bombay High Court has sought answers from the Election Commission of India regarding the automated rejection of Form 8 applications. The issue arose amidst the Goa Special Summary Revision controversy.

headline: Goa Disaster Response Put to Test in Mock Drill
summary: Goa's emergency preparedness and disaster-response systems were put to the test using simulated crisis scenarios. The drills evaluated the coordination and speed of various safety departments.

headline: Protest Marches Demanded Until Election Chief Resigns
summary: The CJP has announced protest marches in Goa, Bengaluru, and Kolkata to demand the resignation of Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The protests are set to continue until their demands are met.

headline: 88 Left-Out Goa Voters Enrolled Via Form 6
summary: Goa's Chief Electoral Officer confirmed that 88 out of the 97 left-out voters have successfully filed Form 6. Their applications have been formally accepted for inclusion in the roll.

headline: FTAs Open Global Markets for Goa's Cashew and Coconut
summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan stated that Free Trade Agreements will open up new international markets for Goa’s cashews and coconuts. This development is expected to benefit local agricultural producers.

headline: Nightclub Owners Offer Compensation to Fire Victims' Kin
summary: Owners of a Goa nightclub have offered an ex gratia payment of Rs 15 lakh to the families of those killed in a recent fire. The Bombay High Court has sought a formal response regarding this offer.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Explains Decision to Move to Goa
summary: A couple from Bengaluru with monthly expenses of Rs 1.3 lakh shared their reasons for relocating to Goa. They highlighted the shift in lifestyle and priorities that prompted their move.

headline: TVS MotoSoul 6.0 to Return to Goa in December
summary: The sixth edition of TVS MotoSoul is scheduled to take place in Goa on December 11 and 12. The event is a popular festival celebrating motorcycling culture, music, and community.

headline: MAD's Rob Finds Success in Creative Endeavors
summary: Popular television host Rob from the show MAD is currently thriving in his creative ventures and earning more than ever. He has transitioned into new platforms while maintaining his love for art and DIY.

headline: Traveller Questions High Cost of Goa Tourism
summary: A traveller sparked online debate by questioning the high cost of domestic tourism, comparing a Rs 35,000 stay in Goa with a Rs 10,000 alternative in Bali. The viral post raised concerns about pricing for local tourists.

headline: Form 6 Accepted for 88 Left-Out Goa Voters
summary: The Chief Electoral Officer of Goa announced that 88 out of 97 voters left out during the special revision have filed Form 6. Their applications have been accepted to restore their voting status.

headline: 88 Voters Re-enrolled Amid Goa SIR Row
summary: Amidst the Special Summary Revision row, 88 of the 97 excluded voters in Goa have submitted Form 6. Their applications have been successfully accepted for re-enrolment.

headline: Elite Referees Selected for India Friendlies
summary: Elite World Cup referees have been appointed to officiate India's upcoming international friendly football matches. This step aims to ensure high standards of officiating during the games.

headline: Vande Bharat Express Extended to Yesvantpur
summary: The Goa-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express has been extended up to Yesvantpur in Bengaluru. Passengers can now check the newly released timings and stoppage schedules for the route.

headline: Actor Aadesh Chaudhary Shares Love for Goa
summary: Television actor Aadesh Chaudhary revealed that he has visited Goa more than 20 times. He expressed his deep affection for the coastal state and its unique vibe.

headline: Land Cleared for Parcem Affordable Housing Project
summary: The Goa state government has cleared land to facilitate the first affordable housing project in Parcem. The initiative is aimed at providing budget-friendly homes to residents.

headline: Panaji and Porvorim SDPOs Swap Charges
summary: In a surprise administrative move, the Sub-Divisional Police Officers of Panaji and Porvorim have swapped their charges. The change in postings was implemented with immediate effect.

headline: Margao Bus Stand Project Delayed by Red Tape
summary: The tender process for the Margao bus stand development has hit a roadblock due to government red tape. Commuters continue to face inconvenience as the project remains stalled.

headline: Inquiry Launched Into Betim Dog Deaths
summary: Authorities have initiated an investigation into the mysterious deaths of several dogs in Betim. Animal welfare groups and locals are demanding action against those responsible.

headline: Goa's GST Revenue Falls 10% Short of Target
summary: Goa's Goods and Services Tax collections have fallen 10% short of the state's annual target. Officials are analyzing the deficit to improve revenue generation in the coming months.

headline: HC Issues Notice to Speaker Over Bungalow Construction
summary: The Bombay High Court has issued a notice to Goa Assembly Speaker Ramesh Tawadkar regarding an allegedly unauthorized bungalow. The court's move comes in response to a petition challenging the construction.

headline: Senior Citizen Panels Remain Defunct in Goa
summary: Goa’s senior citizen panels have reportedly been defunct since March 2025, even as the state celebrates Elders' Day. This inactivity has raised concerns regarding support services for the elderly.

headline: EC Details Status of 97 Left-Out Goa Voters
summary: The Election Commission has released the status of 97 left-out voters in Goa, noting that 88 applications have been accepted under Form 6. Additionally, three individuals were identified as holding Portuguese passports.

headline: President Appointed for Administrative Tribunal
summary: The Goa government has officially appointed a new president for the state's administrative tribunal. The appointment is expected to help expedite pending cases and resolve legal disputes.

headline: Dengue Cases Spike Across Goa
summary: A sudden spike in dengue cases has raised alarm among health authorities and residents across Goa. Officials are urging citizens to take preventive measures to control mosquito breeding.

headline: Goa Records Driest Monsoon in 50 Years
summary: Goa has recorded its driest monsoon season in five decades, leading to concerns over water scarcity. The deficit in rainfall is expected to impact agricultural output in the state.

headline: Goa Taps Only 14.5% of Its Solar Potential
summary: Despite possessing a solar power potential of 6,750 MW, Goa has only tapped 14.5% of its capacity so far. Experts emphasize the need for stronger initiatives to boost green energy adoption.

headline: Officials Cite SC Ruling for Electoral Revision
summary: Election officials in Goa have cited a Supreme Court ruling to justify their actions during the ongoing electoral roll revision. The move aims to address criticisms surrounding the voter list update.

headline: Special Voter Drive Targets First-Time Voters
summary: A special voter enrolment drive is being launched in Goa to register left-out individuals and first-time voters. The initiative aims to ensure maximum participation in the upcoming electoral processes.

headline: Congress Alleges Voter Suppression in Goa
summary: The AICC General Secretary has accused the BJP of voter suppression and introduced the term 'Votebandi' to describe the exclusion of eligible voters in Goa. The opposition is calling for immediate remedial measures.

headline: HC Asks EC to Explain Removal of Six Voters
summary: The Bombay High Court has questioned the Election Commission over the sudden removal of six names from Goa's electoral rolls. The court has demanded an explanation for the glitch that led to this error.

headline: Coast Guard Rescues Sick Sailor Off Goa Coast
summary: The Indian Coast Guard successfully evacuated an ill crew member from a merchant vessel operating off the coast of Goa. The sailor was transported safely to receive urgent medical care.

headline: 'Goa Fresh' Brand to Be Launched Tomorrow
summary: The Union Agriculture Minister is scheduled to launch 'Goa Fresh', a new agricultural brand, tomorrow. The initiative aims to promote local Goan produce and support the farming community.

headline: Minister Praises 'Swayampurna Goa' Initiative
summary: The Union Agriculture Minister has praised the 'Swayampurna Goa' initiative as an exemplary model for a self-reliant India. During his speech, he also criticized the Congress party's ongoing political campaigns.

headline: CM Sawant Urges Citizens to Build Drug-Free India
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant called upon citizens to follow Mahatma Gandhi's ideals and actively contribute toward making India drug-free. He emphasized community involvement in eradicating substance abuse.
